The internal record id leaks into the identifier and the value is not a URL, although the element carries no isPermaLink="false" and so is declared to be a permalink. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/tags.rss)
findings.expected: Each item's <guid> should hold just the tag page URL (e.g. https://5503-…/eval/harbor-handbook/releases/tag/agent15-tag-alpha), so readers treat it as a permalink; no internal id prefix should appear.
findings.actual: Every item's identifier is written as "guid<number>: https://…" — e.g. <guid>guid22: https://5503-…/releases/tag/agent15-tag-msg</guid> and <guid>guid7: …/releases/tag/agent15-tag-alpha</guid>. The internal record id leaks into the identifier and the value is not a URL, although the element carries no isPermaLink="false" and so is declared to be a permalink.
reproSteps: Open https://5503-ix53mp4wf8f2notzyki52.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/tags (signed in as eval)

findings.name: A 255-character title of wide characters is silently cut to 131 characters plus \"…\" when the release is saved
findings.summary: The saved release holds only 132 characters: \"agent5-cjk-\" + 120 × 漢 + \"…\" (374 bytes). The remaining characters were dropped silently — the \"…\" shows the app cut the title itself. Same result with a 255-character block-character title (\"agent5-255-\" + 120 × █ + \"…\", tag agent5-len-255), while a 255-character ASCII title (tag agent5-len-ascii) and a 255-character \"agent5-acc-ééé…\" title (tag agent5-len-accents, 499 bytes) are stored whole. So the field accepts 255 characters but wide characters are cut at ~131 with no message. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/releases/new)
findings.expected: Either the title is stored exactly as typed (255 characters, the limit the field itself enforces), or it is refused with a clear message next to the field. No characters are dropped without telling the person.
findings.actual: The saved release holds only 132 characters: \"agent5-cjk-\" + 120 × 漢 + \"…\" (374 bytes). The remaining characters were dropped silently — the \"…\" shows the app cut the title itself. Same result with a 255-character block-character title (\"agent5-255-\" + 120 × █ + \"…\", tag agent5-len-255), while a 255-character ASCII title (tag agent5-len-ascii) and a 255-character \"agent5-acc-ééé…\" title (tag agent5-len-accents, 499 bytes) are stored whole. So the field accepts 255 characters but wide characters are cut at ~131 with no message.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-ix53mp4wf8f2notzyki52.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/releases/new
Type the tag name "agent5-len-cjk"
Type a release title of exactly 255 characters made of "agent5-cjk-" plus 漢 repeated (the title field stops at its 255-character limit)
Click "Save Draft" (the release is created, list shows it with a Draft badge)
